ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; estimated 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white central field to low-intensity black perimeter and focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white contiguous region; dense black perimeter banding along the entire trailing edge; distinctive irregular black vertical projection originating at the median notch; dense cluster of black mottling at the peduncle base transitioning into scattered focal spots in the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree angle; depth extends roughly 12% into the vertical fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-8 pixels across the continuous trailing edge; characterized by jagged peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; convex near the peduncle attachment, transitioning to slight concavity along the mid-span, terminating in sharp, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive white high-contrast clusters located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes against the black border; secondary clusters visible on the outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent thin horizontal black linear mark in the lower-central white field; several faint, unaligned diagonal disruptions on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe; distinctive drip-shaped black pigmentation mark extending downward from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The basal pigmentation boundary is highly irregular with a 'splatter' morphology where it meets the white ventral surface.
